g.text: DeepSeek Sparse Attention, one decode step in one layer (V3.2 sizes)
cache: indexer keys k_I (T x 128, FP8)
cache: latents (T x 576, FP8 + bf16 RoPE)
scores I(t,s) = sum_j w_j ReLU(q_j . k_s)
core attention, MQA mode: q (128 heads) over the 2048 selected latents,
each latent is key and value
indexer scan: T keys x 64 heads x 128 dims, FP8 (linear in T)
core attention: 2048 entries x 128 heads x 576 (constant in T)
Stored per token per layer: 656 B latent row + 132 B indexer key = 788 B
